== Notes ==
* This skill creates a [[Spirit of Winter]].
* Mechanically, this skill is vastly different than how [[Conflagration]], [[Greater Conflagration]], [[Kindle Arrows]] and elemental [[bowstring]]s work:
** [[Spirit of Winter]] will not allow you to trigger the requirement of [[Conjure Frost]], as it changes the elemental damage '''received''' to cold, rather than change the damage '''output''' of an elemental weapon to cold. 
** [[Conflagration]], [[Greater Conflagration]], [[Kindle Arrows]] and Elemental [[bowstring]]s change the damage type '''output''' to fire or other elements, which allows you to trigger conjure spells with them, but not with Winter.
* Because of this, Winter will not stop [[Conjure Flame]] from working with [[Kindle Arrows]] when under it's effect; it will simply change the final damage caused on the enemy from Fire to Cold Damage.
** Hence winter will not ever activate [[Conjure Frost]] on you, but will be able to activate cold damage reception triggers on the enemy such as [[Spinal Shivers]].
* Great synergy with skills like [[Mantra of Frost]] or [[Spinal Shivers]].
{{anomaly|Unlike [[Greater Conflagration]] or [[Conflagration]] this skill requires ''either'' the attacker or the damage receiver to be inside the spirit [[area of effect]].}}
